Text: I ain't givin' up just yet. Amongst all that ancient knowledge, there has to be a technique for givin' phantoms tangible form!
Shame about Gerolt's new techniques, but at least yer phantom weaponry ain't goin' anywhere. 'Ope it serves ye well on the battlefield!
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! You won't believe this, but Nimuili has been far more reckless than I thought!
She's ventured deep into the wilds, even going to settlements that are far from friendly, simply to share music. Are all adventurers so heedless of danger?
...By your expression, I take it I'm grumbling to the wrong person. \\<sigh> I pity whoever it is that has to wait and worry while you're off risking life and limb.
Oh, it's you again. I owe you an apology─it seems you spent a good deal of time looking for me...
But thanks to you, I was able to reconnect with Bathu. We've talked about all sorts of things, like what we did after the Calamity, what we intend to do now, and─of course─music!
By the by, you're called ObjectParameter(1), ,1)>, right? I'd heard the name before in rumors, but you couldn't possibly be that ObjectParameter(1), ,1)>...could you?
So you've come here too, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>. Somehow, I had sensed that we would meet during the Rising.
To look back upon the past that it may never fade while fixing one's gaze upon the future... 'Tis a mortal practice that I cherish.
I too have much to remember this time of year, but above all, I find myself remembering my fellow Twelve. For I bear their hopes in my heart as I continue my journey.
Ook! Ook!
Greetings. Would you care to travel to the Dire Deepcroft?
The Dire Deepcroft awaits! Shall I escort you there, good <If(PlayerParameter(4))>madam<Else/>sir</If>?
The Haunted Manor is now accepting guests for the marvelous masquerade! Shall I escort you to the front door?
Preparations for the festivities are presently underway, but do come back soon!
I am dreadfully sorry, but you must first speak with my master before I can escort you.
As far as I can glean, it seems the expedition's faring well. Good luck on your excursions!
Slowly but surely we hone in on the truth. All will be revealed if we can but reach the Tower of Magic!
The crew are content for the time bein', but if this drags on, exhaustion's bound to set in. Best we solve these mysteries while the gettin's good!
Leave base security up to me an' the crew. No need to worry while yer out there fightin' fiends an' whatnot!
Triple Triad? I think I understand the rules, more or less. Tell you what─beat me, and I'll share with you how I made my fortune.
Hah, that was pretty fun! If you're still curious how I made so much gil, we can always go again.
Fine, I'll tell you... It was bugards, along the coast of Misareaux. I made a hundred million gil selling their skins and tusks in town.

The skins sold best if they were a higher quality, going for around 1,650 gil each. Better move fast though─word has it there's a surplus on the market, and some merchants will only offer a measly 412 gil for them now.
A draw? Well that's no fun. I say we keep going until one of us is the winner.
A card game, eh? After winning lots against ten of my friends for this hat, I am feeling rather lucky. Sure, why not?
And my lucky streak continues! Hopefully this keeps up the next time I'm in Dynamis. If you're keen to see how long my luck lasts, by all means, let's play again.
Good grief... Maybe I used up all my luck on this chapeau.
If there's no winner, we simply have to go again. I must warn you, however, that as a red mage, I am well suited to battles of attrition.
If you love Aunt Tii's Tacos, you may also like...Triple Triad! Don't see the connection? Let's play anyway!
I...I won! My heart was beating so quickly... Let's go again sometime, all right?
Agh! You play better than most of our regulars... I'll be sure to practice, so don't think this is over!
Pffft... I almost got you! Ending in a tie is no fun, so play me again! Hurry up, now!
Finally! One hundred million gil! All that farming really paid off.
Fancy my hat, do you? This, my friend, is a duelist's chapeau. Considering the great lengths I went to procure it, I'll be damned if anyone takes it.

Thank you for helping Aunt Tii's Tacos thrive, ObjectParameter(1), ,1)>! Oh, Mama has told me all about you. To be clear, you may be her favorite “niecenephew,” but I'm her daughter─so I'll do my share in keeping her dreams alive!
I'll let you know when discussions are set to resume. Until then, please do get some rest!
I will continue to keep abreast of the situation in Garlemald via reports from the Ilsabard contingent. Should another crisis arise, we will not hesitate to provide our support.
You ought to let Jullus know you met with Zero. I'm sure he'll wish to hear she's faring well.
As the Word of the Mother, Minfilia conveyed the will of the star. Surely she would've known if nature itself ran counter to that will...
We must needs ascertain the veracity of Halmarut's claims. I shall send word to my colleagues in Sharlayan─they may be able to offer us valuable insights.
When you have a moment, I should like to hear more of your trip to the Thirteenth.
Knowing that a connection persists between the First and the Thirteenth fills me with joy.
I wonder whose voice it was that named the key “Ethos.” The more we learn, the more mysteries abound!
Sounds like you faced a tough fight in the void. I know your instinct is to charge into the fray, but even heroes need rest.
Few tales of Tural reach Corvos, even today. I'd like to hear of your adventures next time we meet.
I'd been making headway with my training, but I have a long way to go compared to present company... I look forward to learning from the very best again someday!
Looks like there's a lull in the conversation... This is my chance!
Aenor... At least feign a little interest in your sister. This obsession has gone too far!
Alphinaud and Alisaie saw fit to relinquish their responsibilities in Garlemald and concentrate on the fight ahead. I shall likewise be reprising my duties as a Scion─wherever they may take me.
Golbez is even stronger than Barbariccia was! I thought it best to keep out of his way.
That said, Farfarello tells me Golbez isn't so frightening these days...
Perhaps he absorbed the will of someone less terrifying?
No longer will I partake of the aether of other beings─not even if I shrivel and starve!
Good to see you, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>. The woods have been blissfully quiet of late thanks to you and Bakool Ja Ja. Perhaps a little too quiet for his liking, I think.
It seems he still pays visits to Jeuno from time to time. He would never admit it, but I think he's lonely now that Alxaal and Prishe are gone.
If you've time to spare, I'm sure he'd be glad for your company.
Though we've stopped Sareel Ja, the magicks that created Jeuno have yet to fade. Needless to say, many here find it cause for concern.
But I see it as an opportunity, for that echo of a city may yet prove a bridge between our world and Vana'diel. You can be sure the Landsguard intends to keep it under close watch.
I met someone else who moved from Alexandria the other day, and I thought it'd be nice to mark the occasion with a song they might know.
It made them so happy they cried! I couldn't believe it. Said hearing something so familiar reminded them of home.
I wonder if Prishe feels the same when her friend from the choir sings. She could be listening to them sing right now!
I worked as a courier in Alexandria, and for a mercy, I was able to find a similar job delivering goods here in Tuliyollal.

Living amongst such a diverse people is still taking some getting used to. I feared my deliveries might be met with cold stares and silence, but the people here have all been so very welcoming. I think Scoria and I are going to love living here.
My moogle companion recently taught me about merit points, which can be used to further improve my abilities.

The hunting required for it demands considerable offensive capabilities, and so my comrades were often reluctant to let me join them... Which is why I gave up my sword and shield for two-handed blades.
I don't suppose you know anything about the Bushin, do you? It is said he will grant a black belt to monks who have proven their mastery of the fist.

There's a Tarutaru around here somewhere who claims to know where the Bushin is, but he'll only tell me if I can fulfill a number of preposterous requests. I already managed to get a hold of the wyrm beard he wanted, but now he wants a behemoth tongue!
The smart thing to do would be to stick with my brown belt and leave well enough alone, but the increased speed and resilience the black belt offers is too great to ignore!
Every time I think I've rrreached my potential, there's always one man I can rrrely on to push me past my limits.
He asks for the most peculiar things, like papyrus and rrrusty knickknacks, but his final trial is a fight against the old man himself.
I've already lost to him twenty times now... “Don't think I'm forcing you,” he says, but it just makes me want to trrry harder. Next time, I plan to overwhelm him with a barrage of Aero III!
My work with the dhalmels serves as the foundation for future astroveterinary studies. With hard work, we'll expand our range of species one day!
Vacationer <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! Resting hard or hardly resting? Ha!
I say, what is the Studium's obsession with touching our ears? Don't they realize it tickles!?
...Ahem. Nevertheless, our cordial partnership shall continue for the foreseeable future. The scholars of Sharlayan are ever welcome to visit us!
You and yours have completed countless important missions for us. For the sake of our future research, I pray you keep up the good work.
Have your keen eyes spotted the seasonal pool built out there in the deep? A most prestigious venue, it was constructed exclusively for courageous and fortunate souls!
If you're of a mind to visit, why not jump in one of those giant cannons? Perhaps you'll fall inelegantly into the water. Or perhaps you'll be perfectly propelled onto the platform!
Some claim that Lady Luck smiles upon one cannon in particular...but there's only one way to find out, isn't there?
Every contribution upon Auxesia is a show of goodwill towards the Nagylvi people. I hope you and the crew will stick around for a good long while.
Good day to you! My name is Inspectingway, and I am come from the moon in search of researchers willing to assist in interstellar advancement!
Alas, it seems everyone here has a great deal on their plates already. I wish I could help them...
I hear the Studium recently bore witness to the birth of a new academic discipline called “interstellar studies.” Indeed, my comrade Searchingway was well pleased!
Now that his Cosmic Exploration Initiative has established a base of operations on the moon, here I am, hoping to recruit Studium scholars for collaborative research!
Scholars of the Studium have now conducted field trips upon two different stars: Oizys and Auxesia. Not to boast, but it's a great achievement for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.
In fact, through careful coordination with a Loporrit associate presently in the field, I myself helped to facilitate them! Both proved a roaring success!
Now I hear that the professors of the Studium are in talks to debut a new Faculty of Interstellar Studies... Oh, how wonderful to think I may have helped that along, too!

Oh, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, how can I ever thank you? The Cosmic Exploration Initiative truly couldn't have come this far without the many contributions of artisans like you!
Having achieved our greatest ambitions, and tied up some loose ends on Etheirys, I daresay we've earned a spot of peace and quiet.
Our journey is far from over, and may one day take us to a new star─but until then, we'll study every ilm of Auxesia to ensure its story is preserved!
Thank you ever so much for accompanying me all the way to Gyr Abania. My last lingering regret has been resolved─and I learned I've got my own line of merchandise!
In all seriousness, I owe you much and more. Never would I have found my way back to the burrow had you not stopped on the street that day in Old Sharlayan.
Already I find myself pining for new locales in need of names...but for now, I shall concentrate my efforts here at Searchingway's side!
Thankfully, I managed to procure a great many foodstuffs during our tenure on the South Horn. I wonder if these lands will prove as hospitable...
If you find yourself beset by multiple fiends, retreat and save your skin! On an isle as dangerous as this, acts of heroism are a fine way to get oneself killed...
It's a blessin' yer able to leave the island. No matter how tenuous, that connection with the outside world's keepin' spirits up among the crew.
By popular demand, I've elected to reprise my role as overseer of operations. My whiskers are bristling in anticipation of progress reports!
It's a joy to speak freely. Observation is all well and good, but dialogue is the true source of new discoveries!
I was glad to hear about the other ventures from you.
In fact, I have a proposal taking shape in my head... If you can spare a moment, could you speak with me again later?
I'm truly grateful for all you've done. When the crew finally leave, I shall have to treat everyone to a sumptuous Nymian banquet!
Couldn't keep away? Heh. I don't blame you. I'll be the first to admit this place has a hold on me...
The withdrawal operation's keepin' me busy, but I'll be sure to take in as much o' the scenery while I can.
Ye'd think me a plumber what with all the circuitry inspection they been askin' of me!
Gah hah hah! Ye should have seen Mumukko runnin' left an' right in that getup! Maybe now she knows how the rest of us feel, eh!?
Yet she sure don't show it, if so. Task after task after bloody task... Seems damn near nothin' gets 'er down!
So the expedition is to be kept a secret...
I reckon I'll pay the crew a visit before the expedition ends. After all, it'd be a shame if I never got to see the island myself!
I must say, I've learned a great deal from observing your combat techniques. I hope you join us on another expedition one day!
I wonder if there will be room on the ship for all the tools I've fabricated since arriving. It would be a shame to leave them behind...

Thankfully, we managed to avoid unearthing any deadly ancient diseases on the isle. Nonetheless, I shall not be taking any risks. Every crew member will receive a thorough medical examination before they leave.
With the barrier gone and them arcane powers dispelled, this isle won't be claimin' any more ships. Could this be the end o' the legend o' Shades' Triangle?
Please take care of yourselves out there!
My daughter's condition is much improved. Were it not for present circumstances, I should have dearly liked to take her outside for a stroll...
Tertium'll be safe enough in our hands. You're needed on the front lines!
The Ilsabard contingent is defending Lapis Manalis. For a blessing, reports indicate they have the upper hand!
Rest assured that we are doing all we can to treat the wounded.
More sodding voidsent... I suppose I really ought to get out there and help my comrades.
We have more than enough supplies to weather the storm. A crisis like this underscores the benefit of restraint during times of plenty.
Voidsent? Again!?
So you met with Zero...
Honestly, once I gave you the dumplings, I realized it was a silly request. After all, there was no guarantee you'd see her.
I'm glad you did, of course. Let's hope the day comes when such treats are commonplace in the void.
Voidsent aren't our only worry. Malfunctioning magitek and fell fiends remain an ever-present threat.
Garlemald and its people have endured so much... We cannot let this crisis undo the progress they have made.
I heard that fissures tend to manifest in locations with a deep connection to the void. Thankfully, my hometown seems to have escaped unscathed.
I understand Radz–at–Han has already sent aid to Garlemald. That a neutral state would provide help of their own volition is most heartening!
As reports stream in, we continue to dispatch squadrons to affected locales. We're counting on you and your comrades!
Let the voidsent come! We who overcame the Final Days will not so easily succumb to despair!
With all the progress we've made, I had begun to think we might adopt a less defensive posture. A good thing the Ilsabard contingent chose to maintain a presence here...
I have many a dear friend among the Garlean community. I sincerely hope they are all safe...
This camp currently houses some few victims of the voidsent incursion. We shall see that they do not come to further harm.
Though many Garleans were initially skeptical of healing magicks, there are few who would now refuse such treatment. This change in perception has been a boon for our current efforts.
Though other nations likewise struggle to contain the invasion, they continue to send aid. It is encouraging to see our bonds endure, even as crisis grips the star.
Ah, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>. Thankfully, the camp is safe enough. There are others in far greater need of your assistance.
I understand the Clyteum has been purged of voidsent. You'll have to forgive the meager hospitality, but know that we all deeply appreciate your efforts.
It would seem that Alphinaud and Alisaie have returned. Please do all you can to assist them!
Not only was the contingent successful in sealing the fissures on their front, but I'm also told you helped secure the Clyteum. We can rest easy...
I was told of your encounter with Halmarut. I confess, I have no knowledge of this “natural rejoining.”
Nor do I know whether Hydaelyn was aware of such a phenomenon.
Regardless, it was Her unshakable faith in mankind that led Her to entrust the future to you. That faith was not misplaced, was it?
Leave me be...
Ever since she brought you to this domain, our numbers have swelled. We grow tired of conflict...
That must be Golbez. I would gladly consume his aether...if I stood the slightest chance of not being gobbled up first.
I waited an eternity for Zeromus to save this world, but my faith was misplaced.
In the end, it was Zero who brought us hope. She's the reason I keep coming back here, day after day.
How are you faring, mortal?
I've been training to alter my form just like Zero. I'll be the very essence of beauty, just you wait and see!
Well, I appear to have made a complete recovery after the ignominy of starving to death... Maybe my fellow voidsent here can be trusted.
It appears the transfer of Light to the void was successful. Knowing that Zero is able to make use of our surplus is no small comfort.
If there is a weakening in the barriers between worlds, the effects will be felt in the First sooner than later. We shall have to remain vigilant.
Ethos... So that's its name. Though the mechanism is unclear, it took you where you wished to go.
I was less enthused to learn of Calyx's survival... Anyway, I shall continue my investigation. Take care of yourself, and keep in touch.
These revelations are dire, but the flame of hope yet burns bright. We will find a solution... For her sake, if nothing else.
Have faith in yourself, and follow your path wheresoever it may lead.
Zero is amazing! Truly Golbez's equal in every sense!
At long last, I can finally take action... I'll tell you more whenever you have the time!
